A '''Gormak male''' was the leader of a particularly ruthless and savage [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] clan on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Bloodthirsty, the leaders' group ambushed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bacara (Jedi)|Bacara]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kosh (Jedi)|Kosh]] in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ruins, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the former and severely injuring the latter. Upon request from Kosh, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen managed to kill the leader and successfully recover the stolen relics.
